description: Stress-test a plan or design by interviewing the owner about it: maximize question coverage — every assumption, every edge, every dependency, every implicit decision gets a question. Use whenever planning is needed — a plan or design is about to be locked, a large task is about to start — and on the direct ask "grill me" / "прожарь меня". Batched asks are the norm: cover everything, resolve branch by branch, record confirmed answers at once.
